observer: macmon 1Hz plus one app-scoped counter snapshot per second; baseline scans observer group for similar collection work

metrics.app_cpu_percent_one_core: sum CPU time / wall time * 100; 100%=one logical CPU
metrics.app_cpu_energy_w: estimated process CPU energy only, excludes GPU rail and display
metrics.app_gpu_ms_per_s: sum live app GPU queue execution time / wall time, not GPU core occupancy
metrics.sys_power: system power estimate; cannot be attributed entirely to the app
